1	# game_over.gd - handles game over screen and high score input
2	extends Control
3	
4	@onready var leader_board: VBoxContainer = $leader_board
5	@onready var initials_input: LineEdit = $initials_input
6	@onready var submit_button: Button = $submit_button
7	@onready var restart_button: Button = $restart_button
8	
9	var current_score: int
10	
11	func _ready() -> void:
12		add_to_group("ui_hidden")
13		get_tree().paused = true  # Ensure paused to freeze game
14		# Explicitly hide UI
15		var ui = get_node_or_null("/root/UI")
16		if ui:
17			ui.visible = false
18		else:
19			push_error("GameOver: UI node not found at /root/UI!")
20		if leader_board:
21			leader_board.process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS
22		if initials_input:
23			initials_input.process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS
24		if submit_button:
25			submit_button.process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS
26		if restart_button:
27			restart_button.process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS
28		if $quit_button:
29			$quit_button.process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS
30		if not leader_board:
31			push_error("GameOver: leader_board is null!")
32		if not initials_input:
33			push_error("GameOver: initials_input is null!")
34		if not submit_button:
35			push_error("GameOver: submit_button is null!")
36		if not restart_button:
37			push_error("GameOver: restart_button is null!")
38		current_score = Global.current_score
39		update_leader_board()
40		if not Global.is_high_score(current_score):
41			if initials_input:
42				initials_input.hide()
43			if submit_button:
44				submit_button.hide()
45		else:
46			if initials_input:
47				initials_input.grab_focus()
48		# Pause the survival stopwatch
49		Global.game_active = false
50	
51	func _input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
52		if event.is_action_pressed("interact"):
53			var focused_control = get_viewport().gui_get_focus_owner()
54			if focused_control:
55				if focused_control == submit_button:
56					_on_submit_button_pressed()
57				elif focused_control == restart_button:
58					_on_restart_button_pressed()
59			if focused_control == initials_input:
60				_on_initials_input_text_submitted(initials_input.text)
61	
62	func update_leader_board() -> void:
63		if not leader_board:
64			push_error("GameOver: Cannot update leaderboard, leader_board is null!")
65			return
66		for i in range(10):
67			var label: Label = leader_board.get_node_or_null("score_" + str(i + 1))
68			if not label:
69				push_error("GameOver: score_%d is null!" % (i + 1))
70				continue
71			if i < Global.high_scores.size():
72				var entry: Dictionary = Global.high_scores[i]
73				label.text = "%s - Score: %d | Coins: %d | Wave: %d | Saved: %d | Lost: %d | Time: %s" % [
74					entry.initials, entry.score, entry.coins, entry.wave, entry.saved_villagers, entry.lost_villagers, Global.format_time(entry.time_survived)
75				]
76			else:
77				label.text = "--- - Score: 0 | Coins: 0 | Wave: 0 | Saved: 0 | Lost: 0 | Time: 00:00"
78	
79	# Handle initials submission
80	func _on_initials_input_text_submitted(new_text: String) -> void:
81		if new_text.length() > 0:
82			Global.add_high_score(current_score, new_text, Global.current_wave, Global.coins_collected, Global.current_time_survived, Global.saved_villagers, Global.lost_villagers)
83			update_leader_board()
84			if initials_input:
85				initials_input.hide()
86			if submit_button:
87				submit_button.hide()
88			if restart_button:
89				restart_button.grab_focus()
90	
91	# Handle submit button press
92	func _on_submit_button_pressed() -> void:
93		if initials_input:
94			var text: String = initials_input.text
95			if text.length() > 0:
96				Global.add_high_score(current_score, text, Global.current_wave, Global.coins_collected, Global.current_time_survived, Global.saved_villagers, Global.lost_villagers)
97				update_leader_board()
98				initials_input.hide()
99				submit_button.hide()
100				if restart_button:
101					restart_button.grab_focus()
102	
103	# Restart game
104	func _on_restart_button_pressed() -> void:
105		Global.reset()
106		get_tree().paused = false  # Unpause the game tree
107		get_tree().change_scene_to_file("res://Scenes/main.tscn")
108	
109	# Quit game
110	func _on_quit_button_pressed() -> void:
111		get_tree().quit()
112

1	# global.gd - manages global game state and emits signals for UI updates
2	extends Node
3	
4	# Signals
5	signal villagers_updated(saved: int, lost: int, total: int)
6	signal score_updated(score: int)
7	signal coins_updated(coins: int)
8	signal wave_updated(wave: int)
9	signal time_updated(time: String)
10	
11	var high_scores: Array[Dictionary] = []
12	var current_score: int = 0
13	var current_wave: int = 1
14	var coins_collected: int = 0
15	var current_time_survived: float = 0.0
16	var saved_villagers: int = 0
17	var lost_villagers: int = 0
18	var total_villagers: int = 50
19	var game_active: bool = true
20	var boss_fight_active: bool = false
21	var _boss_triggered: bool = false
22	var godmode: bool = false
23	var guard_spawn_index: int = 0
24	var magi_spawn_index: int = 0
25	
26	# Shop / scene-transition state preservation
27	var shop_purchase_counts: Dictionary = {"health": 0, "damage": 0, "speed": 0, "guard": 0, "magi": 0}
28	
29	func _ready() -> void:
30		var window := get_window()
31		window.content_scale_mode = Window.CONTENT_SCALE_MODE_VIEWPORT
32		window.content_scale_aspect = Window.CONTENT_SCALE_ASPECT_IGNORE
33		window.content_scale_size = Vector2i(1152, 648)
34		DisplayServer.window_set_mode(DisplayServer.WINDOW_MODE_MAXIMIZED)
35		DirAccess.make_dir_absolute("user://saves/")
36		load_high_scores()
37	
38	func _process(delta: float) -> void:
39		if game_active:
40			current_time_survived += delta
41			emit_signal("time_updated", format_time(current_time_survived))
42	
43	func load_high_scores() -> void:
44		var file: FileAccess = FileAccess.open("user://saves/high_scores.json", FileAccess.READ)
45		if file:
46			var json_data = JSON.parse_string(file.get_as_text())
47			if json_data is Array:
48				high_scores = []
49				for item in json_data:
50					if item is Dictionary:
51						var entry: Dictionary = {
52							"score": int(round(item.get("score", 0.0))),
53							"initials": item.get("initials", "AAA").to_upper(),
54							"wave": int(round(item.get("wave", 0.0))),
55							"coins": int(round(item.get("coins", 0.0))),
56							"time_survived": float(item.get("time_survived", 0.0)),
57							"saved_villagers": int(round(item.get("saved_villagers", 0.0))),
58							"lost_villagers": int(round(item.get("lost_villagers", 0.0)))
59						}
60						high_scores.append(entry)
61			file.close()
62		else:
63			# File doesn't exist yet - create default empty scores (first run)
64			high_scores = []
65			save_high_scores()  # Create the file with empty array
66	
67	func save_high_scores() -> void:
68		var dir: DirAccess = DirAccess.open("user://")
69		if not dir.dir_exists("saves"):
70			dir.make_dir("saves")
71		var file: FileAccess = FileAccess.open("user://saves/high_scores.json", FileAccess.WRITE)
72		if file:
73			file.store_string(JSON.stringify(high_scores, "\t"))
74			file.close()
75		else:
76			push_error("Global: Failed to save high_scores.json")
77	
78	func add_high_score(score: int, initials: String, wave: int, coins: int, time_survived: float, saved_villagers: int, lost_villagers: int) -> void:
79		if initials.length() > 3:
80			initials = initials.substr(0, 3)
81		if initials.length() == 0:

21			connect("body_entered", Callable(self, "_on_body_entered"))

23		visible = true

34

38		if collision_shape:
39			collision_shape.set_deferred("disabled", false)
40		if destroy_timer:

42		if projectile_sound:

45			if not projectile_sound.playing:

47		home_target = null

49		rotation = 0.0
50		position = Vector2.ZERO
51		slow_percent = 0.0
52		slow_duration = 0.0
53		modulate = Color.WHITE

56	func _process(delta: float) -> void:
57		if home_target != null and is_instance_valid(home_target) and home_strength > 0.0:
58			var to_target: Vector2 = global_position.direction_to(home_target.global_position)
59			var turn: float = clamp(move_direction.angle_to(to_target), -home_strength * delta, home_strength * delta)
60			move_direction = move_direction.rotated(turn).normalized()
61		if move_direction != Vector2.ZERO:
62			translate(move_direction * speed * delta)
63			rotation = move_direction.angle()

	navigation_agent.target_desired_distance = max(10.0, max_dim * 0.3)
	

func reset() -> void:
	# Reset monster state for reuse
	visible = true
	current_health = max_health
	if health_bar:
		health_bar.max_value = max_health
		health_bar.value = current_health
	velocity = Vector2.ZERO
	_is_rooted = false
	_is_slowed = false
	last_shoot_time = 0.0
	last_damage_source = null
	last_damage_times = {}
	debug_frame_counter = 0
	waypoint_stage = 0  # Reset to stage 0 (village center)
	target_update_timer = 0.0  # Reset target timer
	target = null  # FIXED: Clear target so monster finds new one
	set_process(true)
	set_physics_process(true)
	set_deferred("process_mode", Node.PROCESS_MODE_INHERIT)
	if collision_shape:
		collision_shape.set_deferred("disabled", false)
	if get_parent() is NodePool and global_position == Vector2.ZERO:
		global_position = Vector2.ZERO
	
	# Always defer to be safe
	call_deferred("_update_waypoint")

func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	# NEW: Update target less frequently for performance
	target_update_timer += delta
	if target_update_timer >= TARGET_UPDATE_INTERVAL:
		target_update_timer = 0.0
		_find_nearest_attack_target()
	
	# If we have a target, calculate distance/direction, face it, and shoot
	var has_valid_target: bool = is_instance_valid(target)
	if has_valid_target:
		target_distance = global_position.distance_to(target.global_position)
		target_direction = global_position.direction_to(target.global_position)
		sprite.flip_h = target_direction.x > 0
		
		# Shooting logic
		if target_distance < shoot_range:
			# Only shoot if we have a clear line of sight

content.text:
Everything looks correct. Here's a summary of all the changes made and how the system works end to end:

---

**What was changed (6 files):**

- **`projectile.gd`** — added `var shooter: Node = null`

- **`monsters.gd`** — when a monster fires a projectile, sets `projectile.shooter = self`; when a monster deals melee collision damage, passes `self` instead of `null` so the victim knows who hit them

- **`mh_orzath.gd`** — passes `self` for both Event Horizon and Nihil Storm ability damage

- **`player.gd`** — renamed `_projectile_instance` to `source`, added `_identify_killer(source)` helper that traces projectile → shooter or uses the melee attacker directly (extracts the script filename like `"goblin"`, `"skeleton"`, etc.), stores it in `Global.killer_name` on death

- **`global.gd`** — added `killer_name: String`, clears on reset; updated `add_high_score()` with optional `epitaph` param (stored + persisted to JSON); added `static func generate_epitaph(killer)` with 2–3 funny lines per enemy type (goblin, skeleton, troll, wraith, beholder, lich, hezrou, ogre, ghost, balrog, mh_orzath)

- **`game_over.gd` / `game_over2.gd`** — generates the epitaph from `Global.killer_name` on the game over screen, passes it when submitting initials, and displays it as a second indented line under each leaderboard entry that has one

**The wall will look like:**
```
RWW - Score: 5000 | Coins: 20 | Wave: 5 | Saved: 30 | Lost: 20 | Time: 01:23
  "RWW: crushed underfoot by a troll's terrible bulk"
```

Old high score entries without a killer just show single-line as before.

content.text: The issue is clear. The magi uses `size` and `position` to set bar dimensions — Godot can override `size` with the ProgressBar theme's minimum height after the node is added. The fix is to use the same offset approach, matching the guard/tenchijin/annadaeus values exactly.

content.text: The crash is a pre-existing null-safety gap — `collision.get_collider()` can return `null` when a body gets freed mid-frame, and line 409 doesn't check for that before calling `is_in_group`. Line 382 just calls `_process_collisions()`, so it appears in the stack trace pointing there. The fix is a single null check.

content.text: `get_collider()` returns `null` when the collider node has been freed before the collision is processed — this happens when bodies are despawned mid-frame (e.g., a guard or magi dying at the same time a monster collides with them). The `is_instance_valid` guard skips those stale collisions cleanly.

# victory_scene.gd - Ending screen shown after Mh'orzath is defeated
extends Control

const FONT_TITLE: FontFile = preload("res://Assets/Fonts/alagard_by_pix3m-d6awiwp.ttf")
const FONT_BODY: FontFile = preload("res://Assets/Fonts/_bitmap_font____romulus_by_pix3m-d6aokem.ttf")

func _ready() -> void:
	add_to_group("ui_hidden")
	get_tree().paused = true
	var ui := get_node_or_null("/root/UI")
	if ui:
		ui.visible = false
	Global.game_active = false
	Global.add_high_score(
		Global.current_score, "WIN",
		Global.current_wave, Global.coins_collected,
		Global.current_time_survived,
		Global.saved_villagers, Global.lost_villagers
	)
	_build_ui()
	_play_victory_music()

func _play_victory_music() -> void:
	var stream := load("res://Assets/Audio/monument_music-keys-of-wisdom-266235.mp3") as AudioStreamMP3
	if stream:
		stream.loop = true
	var player := AudioStreamPlayer.new()
	player.stream = stream
	player.volume_db = -2.0
	player.process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS
	add_child(player)
	player.play()

func _build_ui() -> void:
	# Dark cosmic background
	var bg := ColorRect.new()
	bg.color = Color(0.02, 0.0, 0.06)
	bg.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	bg.process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS
	add_child(bg)

	# Centered content column
	var margin := MarginContainer.new()
	margin.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	margin.add_theme_constant_override("margin_left", 120)
	margin.add_theme_constant_override("margin_right", 120)
	margin.add_theme_constant_override("margin_top", 28)
	margin.add_theme_constant_override("margin_bottom", 28)
	margin.process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS
	add_child(margin)

	var scroll := ScrollContainer.new()
	scroll.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	scroll.horizontal_scroll_mode = ScrollContainer.SCROLL_MODE_DISABLED
	scroll.process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS
	margin.add_child(scroll)

	var vbox := VBoxContainer.new()
	vbox.alignment = BoxContainer.ALIGNMENT_BEGIN
	vbox.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	vbox.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 14)
	vbox.process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS
	scroll.add_child(vbox)

	# THE ECLIPSE LIFTS.
	_label(vbox, "THE ECLIPSE LIFTS.", FONT_TITLE, 54, Color(1.0, 0.88, 0.30))
	_label(vbox, "LIGHT RETURNS TO LUMORA.", FONT_TITLE, 36, Color(1.0, 0.85, 0.42))
	_spacer(vbox, 22)

	# Boss defeated line
	_label(vbox, "MH'ORZATH HAS BEEN BANISHED.", FONT_TITLE, 28, Color(0.90, 0.18, 0.12))
	_spacer(vbox, 26)

	# Stats
	_label(vbox, "50 Villagers Saved", FONT_BODY, 24, Color(0.72, 1.0, 0.72))
	_label(vbox, "%d Waves Survived" % Global.current_wave, FONT_BODY, 24, Color(0.72, 0.88, 1.0))
	_spacer(vbox, 10)
	_label(vbox, "Final Score:       %d" % Global.current_score, FONT_BODY, 20, Color(1.0, 0.90, 0.50))
	_label(vbox, "Solari Collected:  %d" % Global.coins_collected, FONT_BODY, 20, Color(1.0, 0.90, 0.50))
	_label(vbox, "Time Survived:     %s" % Global.format_time(Global.current_time_survived), FONT_BODY, 20, Color(1.0, 0.90, 0.50))
	_spacer(vbox, 30)

	# Closing quote
	_label(vbox, '"The Eclipsed One is sealed once more...', FONT_TITLE, 18, Color(0.62, 0.60, 0.72))
	_label(vbox, ' but shadows have long memories."', FONT_TITLE, 18, Color(0.62, 0.60, 0.72))
	_spacer(vbox, 34)

	# THE END
	_label(vbox, "THE END", FONT_TITLE, 60, Color(1.0, 0.88, 0.30))
	_spacer(vbox, 40)

	# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
	# DEVELOPER THANK YOU MESSAGE
	# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
	_label(vbox, "Thank you for playing Heroes of Lumora!", FONT_TITLE, 22, Color(1.0, 0.95, 0.70))
	_spacer(vbox, 16)
	
	# Create a panel for the message text with word wrap
	var message_panel := PanelContainer.new()
	message_panel.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	message_panel.process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS
	
	# Semi-transparent dark panel background
	var panel_style := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	panel_style.bg_color = Color(0.05, 0.03, 0.10, 0.7)
	panel_style.border_color = Color(0.40, 0.35, 0.50, 0.5)
	panel_style.set_border_width_all(2)
	panel_style.corner_radius_top_left = 8
	panel_style.corner_radius_top_right = 8
	panel_style.corner_radius_bottom_left = 8
	panel_style.corner_radius_bottom_right = 8
	panel_style.content_margin_left = 32
	panel_style.content_margin_right = 32
	panel_style.content_margin_top = 24
	panel_style.content_margin_bottom = 24
	message_panel.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", panel_style)
	vbox.add_child(message_panel)
	
	var message_label := RichTextLabel.new()
	message_label.bbcode_enabled = true
	message_label.fit_content = true
	message_label.scroll_active = false
	message_label.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(700, 0)
	message_label.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	message_label.add_theme_font_override("normal_font", FONT_BODY)
	message_label.add_theme_font_size_override("normal_font_size", 18)
	message_label.add_theme_color_override("default_color", Color(0.88, 0.85, 0.90))
	message_label.process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS
	
	message_label.text = """As a solo developer learning the craft of game creation, this project has been an incredible journey of discovery. Every system, every character, every wave you survived—it all came together through experimentation, perseverance, and genuine passion for bringing this world to life.

Heroes of Lumora is my first game, but it won't be my last. This story is a window into Aldenexia—a world I'm building for my next project, [color=#FFD700]Aldenexia: Lightfall[/color]. The characters you met here, the darkness you fought, and the light you defended are all threads in a much larger tapestry.

I hope you'll join me in Aldenexia when the full story unfolds.

Thank you for defending Lumora.

[color=#B8B080]- Ross Wilkinson[/color]"""
	
	message_panel.add_child(message_label)
	_spacer(vbox, 32)
	# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

	# Buttons
	var btn_row := HBoxContainer.new()
	btn_row.alignment = BoxContainer.ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	btn_row.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 48)
	btn_row.process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS
	vbox.add_child(btn_row)

	var restart_btn := _button("Play Again")
	restart_btn.pressed.connect(_on_restart_pressed)
	btn_row.add_child(restart_btn)
	restart_btn.grab_focus()

	var quit_btn := _button("Quit")
	quit_btn.pressed.connect(_on_quit_pressed)
	btn_row.add_child(quit_btn)

	# Cinematic fade-in from black
	var fade := ColorRect.new()
	fade.color = Color(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0)
	fade.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	fade.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	fade.process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS
	add_child(fade)
	var tween := create_tween()
	tween.set_pause_mode(Tween.TWEEN_PAUSE_PROCESS)
	tween.tween_property(fade, "modulate:a", 0.0, 2.0).set_ease(Tween.EASE_IN)
	tween.tween_callback(fade.queue_free)

func _label(parent: Node, text: String, font: FontFile, size: int, color: Color) -> void:
	var lbl := Label.new()
	lbl.text = text
	lbl.add_theme_font_override("font", font)
	lbl.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", size)
	lbl.add_theme_color_override("font_color", color)
	lbl.add_theme_color_override("font_outline_color", Color(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0))
	lbl.add_theme_constant_override("outline_size", 4)
	lbl.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	lbl.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	lbl.process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS
	parent.add_child(lbl)

func _spacer(parent: Node, height: int) -> void:
	var s := Control.new()
	s.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, height)
	s.process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS
	parent.add_child(s)

func _button(label_text: String) -> Button:
	var btn := Button.new()
	btn.text = label_text
	btn.add_theme_font_override("font", FONT_BODY)
	btn.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 22)
	btn.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(190, 52)
	btn.process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS
	return btn

func _input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
	if event.is_action_pressed("interact"):
		var focused := get_viewport().gui_get_focus_owner()
		if focused is Button:
			focused.emit_signal("pressed")

func _on_restart_pressed() -> void:
	Global.reset()
	get_tree().paused = false
	get_tree().change_scene_to_file("res://Scenes/main.tscn")

func _on_quit_pressed() -> void:
	get_tree().quit()

1. Beat Mh'Orzath → **victory scene** (read the ending, see your stats)
2. Click **"The Wall of Heroes"** → **game_over.tscn** (enter your initials, epitaph reads e.g. `"RWW: stood victorious where others fell"`)
3. Click **"Restart"** on the wall → `Global.reset()` → back to `main.tscn`

4	@export var follow_rate: float = 2.0
5

9

12	var _shake_timer: float = 0.0
13

15	var _base_zoom: float = 1.0
16	var _user_zoom: float = 1.0
17	var _pinch_start_user_zoom: float = 1.0
18	var _pinch_start_distance: float = 0.0
19	var _touch_positions: Dictionary = {}
20	
21	func _ready() -> void:
22		get_viewport().size_changed.connect(_recalc_zoom)
23		_recalc_zoom()
24	
25	func shake(intensity: float, duration: float) -> void:
26		_shake_intensity = intensity
27		_shake_timer = duration
28	
29	func _process(delta: float) -> void:
30		global_position = global_position.lerp(target.global_position, follow_rate * delta)
31		if _shake_timer > 0.0:
32			_shake_timer -= delta
33			offset = Vector2(
34				randf_range(-_shake_intensity, _shake_intensity),
35				randf_range(-_shake_intensity, _shake_intensity)
36			)
37		else:
38			offset = Vector2.ZERO
39	
40	func _recalc_zoom() -> void:
41		# Scale so base_height world-units always fill the viewport vertically.
42		var vp_h := get_viewport().get_visible_rect().size.y
43		if vp_h > 0.0:
44			_base_zoom = vp_h / base_height
45		zoom = Vector2.ONE * (_base_zoom * _user_zoom)
46	
47	func _unhandled_input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
48		# Mouse-wheel zoom
49		if event is InputEventMouseButton and event.is_pressed():
50			if event.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_WHEEL_UP:
51				_user_zoom *= 1.1
52				_recalc_zoom()
53			elif event.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_WHEEL_DOWN:
54				_user_zoom /= 1.1
55				_recalc_zoom()
56	
57		# Touch: track finger positions
58		if event is InputEventScreenTouch:
59			if event.pressed:
60				_touch_positions[event.index] = event.position
61			else:
62				_touch_positions.erase(event.index)
63				if _touch_positions.size() < 2:
64					_pinch_start_distance = 0.0
65	
66		# Pinch-to-zoom
67		if _touch_positions.size() == 2:
68			var pts := _touch_positions.values()
69			var dist: float = pts[0].distance_to(pts[1])
70			if _pinch_start_distance == 0.0:
71				_pinch_start_distance = dist
72				_pinch_start_user_zoom = _user_zoom
73				return
74			_user_zoom = _pinch_start_user_zoom * (dist / _pinch_start_distance)
75			_recalc_zoom()

# main.gd

extends Node2D

# Global light node for dynamic day-night veil
@onready var global_light: DirectionalLight2D = $global_light  

# Process: Update world light and screen overlay based on TimeManager's chronomancy
func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	var hour: float = TimeManager.current_time / 60.0
	# Sin curve peaks at noon (factor=1.0, full brightness) and troughs at midnight (factor=0.0, darkest)
	var sun_factor: float = (sin((hour - 6.0) / 24.0 * TAU) + 1.0) / 2.0
	# Subtract mode: 0.0 = no subtraction (full bright), 0.55 = moonlit night
	var target_subtract: float = lerp(0.55, 0.0, sun_factor)
	global_light.energy = lerp(global_light.energy, target_subtract, 0.05 * delta)
	# Screen overlay: up to 0.45 opacity at midnight, fully transparent at noon
	var target_alpha: float = lerp(0.45, 0.0, sun_factor)
	UI.set_night_alpha(lerp(UI.get_night_alpha(), target_alpha, 0.05 * delta))

Clean. Here's a summary of everything that was fixed:

**Victory scene not playing:**
- Root cause: if the boss's final attack kills the player in the same frame the boss dies, both `_handle_game_over()` and `_on_boss_died()` queue a scene change — whichever fires last wins
- Fix: `_handle_game_over()` now returns immediately if `Global.game_active` is already `false`. Since `_on_boss_died()` sets `game_active = false` before queuing the victory scene, any simultaneous player death is silently ignored

**Grey out-of-bounds tiles:**
- `_setup_map_bounds()` runs on `_ready()` and unions the used-tile rects from all four TileMapLayers (grass, roads, town, walls) to find the exact painted boundary in world pixels
- Camera limits are set so the viewport edge never scrolls past the painted tiles
- Four invisible `StaticBody2D` walls are created around the perimeter on collision layer 5 (value 16), which matches the existing wall tiles that the player already bounces off

Perfect! Now I have all the information I need. Let me compile my findings:

## Touch Controls Analysis Report

### 1. What touch_joystick.gd Does

The `touch_joystick.gd` script (lines 1-36) is a **virtual joystick handler** that:
- Extends `TouchScreenButton` (inherits Godot's touch input system)
- Has a configurable `joystick_size` (200x200) and `radius` (100.0) for the circular movement boundary
- Calculates touch position relative to a `base_position` (center of the joystick)
- Implements `set_action_strength()` which maps touch input to cardinal direction actions:
  - For `move` action: presses "move_left", "move_right", "move_up", "move_down" based on touch direction
  - For `aim` action: presses "aim_left", "aim_right", "aim_up", "aim_down" based on touch direction
  - Shoots when aim strength exceeds 0.2 (deadzone for shooting)

**Critical Issue**: The `set_action_strength()` function exists but is **never called** from anywhere in the codebase.

### 2. How (or if) It's Wired Into Player Movement

**DISCONNECTED** - There are multiple problems:

**In player.gd (line 53)**:
```gdscript
move_input = Input.get_vector("move_left", "move_right", "move_up", "move_down")
```
The player reads these actions but only cares about their pressed state, not the strength values.

**In touch_joystick.gd**:
- The script defines `set_action_strength()` but this is a custom method that's never invoked
- It calls `Input.action_press()` with manual strength values, but `Input.action_press()` in Godot 4 typically expects a boolean state
- The script never implements `_input()` or connects to touch events from the `TouchScreenButton`
- The comment on line 16 says "Remove the _input() function entirely, as TouchScreenButton handles its own input" — but there's no code to handle the input that TouchScreenButton receives

### 3. What's in ui.tscn Related to Touch Controls

# touch_joystick.gd - handles virtual joystick input for touch controls
extends TouchScreenButton

@export var joystick_size: Vector2 = Vector2(200, 200)  # Allow size configuration in Inspector
@export var action_name: String
var base_position: Vector2
var radius: float = 100.0
var action_prefix: String

func _ready() -> void:
	await get_tree().process_frame  # Ensure node is fully initialized
	base_position = position + joystick_size / 2
	print("Base position: ", base_position, " Size: ", joystick_size, " Node: ", name)  # Enhanced debug
	action_prefix = action_name

# Remove the _input() function entirely, as TouchScreenButton handles its own input.

func set_action_strength(touch_pos: Vector2) -> void:
	var delta = (touch_pos - base_position).limit_length(radius)
	var strength = delta.length() / radius
	var direction = delta.normalized()
	if action_prefix == "move":
		Input.action_press("move_left", -direction.x if direction.x < 0 else 0.0)
		Input.action_press("move_right", direction.x if direction.x > 0 else 0.0)
		Input.action_press("move_up", -direction.y if direction.y < 0 else 0.0)
		Input.action_press("move_down", direction.y if direction.y > 0 else 0.0)
	elif action_prefix == "aim":
		Input.action_press("aim_left", -direction.x if direction.x < 0 else 0.0)
		Input.action_press("aim_right", direction.x if direction.x > 0 else 0.0)
		Input.action_press("aim_up", -direction.y if direction.y < 0 else 0.0)
		Input.action_press("aim_down", direction.y if direction.y > 0 else 0.0)
		if strength > 0.2:  # Deadzone for shooting
			Input.action_press("shoot", 1.0)
		else:
			Input.action_release("shoot")

content.text:
Here's my full assessment of all three:

---

## 1. Touch Controls — needs a rewrite

The architecture is right (two joysticks calling `Input.action_press()`, player reading `Input.get_vector()`), but `touch_joystick.gd` is the broken link. It defines `set_action_strength()` but **nothing ever calls it**. The comment even says "remove `_input()` since `TouchScreenButton` handles its own input" — but `TouchScreenButton` only fires a `pressed` signal on tap, it doesn't track finger position while dragging, which is what a joystick needs.

The fix is a full rewrite of `touch_joystick.gd` to extend `Control` instead of `TouchScreenButton`, implement `_gui_input()` to catch `InputEventScreenTouch` and `InputEventScreenDrag`, and drive `Input.action_press()` from there. The scene structure and the player's input reading are both fine — just the joystick script itself needs replacing. I can do this.

---

## 2. Mh'Orzath — Event Horizon already pulls, just too short-range

**Event Horizon** (range 300, pull strength 600) already yanks targets toward the boss — but 300 units is too short for the player to ever get caught at max kiting range. **Nihil Storm** (range 400) is pure damage, no movement.

Recommended changes:
- Event Horizon range: 300 → **500**, pull strength: 600 → **1000** (strong enough to actually drag the player in)
- Nihil Storm range: 400 → **600**

---

## 3. Healing Aura — `max_alpha = 0.1`, nearly invisible

The shader pulse's `max_alpha` is 0.1 (the actual ceiling on opacity). Even at peak pulse it barely shows. Scale is also at 55%.

Recommended changes (scene values, no shader edit needed):
- `shader_parameter/max_alpha`: 0.1 → **0.45**
- `shader_parameter/pulse_speed`: 2.0 → **3.5**
- Scale: 0.55 → **0.9**

---

Want me to go ahead and implement all three? The aura and boss are quick edits. The touch controls rewrite is the most involved but it's a clean problem with a clear solution.
Starting with the quick wins, then the touch rewrite. Let me read the touch controls scene first so I know exactly what I'm working with.

# touch_joystick.gd - handles virtual joystick input for touch controls
extends TouchScreenButton

@export var joystick_size: Vector2 = Vector2(200, 200)  # Allow size configuration in Inspector
@export var action_name: String
var base_position: Vector2
var radius: float = 100.0
var action_prefix: String

func _ready() -> void:
	await get_tree().process_frame  # Ensure node is fully initialized
	base_position = position + joystick_size / 2
	print("Base position: ", base_position, " Size: ", joystick_size, " Node: ", name)  # Enhanced debug
	action_prefix = action_name

# Remove the _input() function entirely, as TouchScreenButton handles its own input.

func set_action_strength(touch_pos: Vector2) -> void:
	var delta = (touch_pos - base_position).limit_length(radius)
	var strength = delta.length() / radius
	var direction = delta.normalized()
	if action_prefix == "move":
		Input.action_press("move_left", -direction.x if direction.x < 0 else 0.0)
		Input.action_press("move_right", direction.x if direction.x > 0 else 0.0)
		Input.action_press("move_up", -direction.y if direction.y < 0 else 0.0)
		Input.action_press("move_down", direction.y if direction.y > 0 else 0.0)
	elif action_prefix == "aim":
		Input.action_press("aim_left", -direction.x if direction.x < 0 else 0.0)

Done. Here's what changed across all three:

**Mh'Orzath (`mh_orzath.gd`)**
- Event Horizon range: 300 → **500**, pull strength: 600 → **1000** — now reaches the player at kiting distance and drags them in hard
- Nihil Storm range: 400 → **600** — no more safe corner to hide in

**Healing aura (`priestess.tscn`)**
- `max_alpha`: 0.1 → **0.45** — 4.5× more opaque at pulse peak
- `pulse_speed`: 2.0 → **3.5** — noticeably faster beat
- Scale: 0.55 → **0.9** — larger visual footprint

**Touch controls (`touch_joystick.gd` + `touch_controls.tscn`)**
The old script extended `TouchScreenButton` which only fires a press/release signal — it has no mechanism to track where your finger drags, which is what a joystick needs. The rewrite:
- Extends `Control` instead
- Uses `_input()` to catch `InputEventScreenTouch` and `InputEventScreenDrag` directly
- Each joystick claims a finger by `index` (so left and right work simultaneously with two fingers)
- Drives `Input.action_press()` with analog strength so movement is proportional to how far you push the stick
- Moves the knob sprite visually to follow your finger within the radius
- Releases all its actions cleanly when the finger lifts
- The `action_name` export replaces the old `TouchScreenButton.action` property — it's set in the scene to `"move"` and `"aim"` respectively

Great to hear! A few things worth knowing before you test on device:

**Touch controls gotcha** — Godot's `OS.has_feature("touchscreen")` returns `false` on desktop even if you have a touchscreen monitor. If you want to test the joysticks on PC before exporting, you can temporarily force them visible by changing the check in `ui.gd`'s `_toggle_touch_controls()`. On actual mobile it'll detect correctly.

**Android export settings to double-check:**
- Project → Export → Android: make sure **"Touch Input"** is enabled under input settings
- The game is set to 1152×648 with `CONTENT_SCALE_MODE_VIEWPORT` — on mobile this will letterbox/pillarbox. If the joysticks end up in wrong screen positions on a different aspect ratio, their positions (165,500) and (990,500) may need adjusting for the actual device resolution.
- Make sure `Input.action_press()` is in your Input Map — check that `move_left`, `move_right`, `move_up`, `move_down`, `aim_left`, `aim_right`, `aim_up`, `aim_down`, and `shoot` are all defined there.

---
name: architecture
description: Key technical details — scripts, physics layers, global state, patterns used
metadata:
  type: project
---

**Global autoload (`global.gd`):** Tracks score, wave, coins, villagers saved/lost, time survived, high scores (JSON at user://saves/high_scores.json), killer_name (for epitaphs), game_active flag, boss_fight_active. `generate_epitaph(killer: String)` is a static function — killer is the script basename of the attacker (e.g. "goblin", "mh_orzath", "victory").

**Physics layers (bitmask values):**
- Layer 5 (value 16): wall tiles and boundary walls — player collides with this
- Player collision_mask = 538 (layers 2, 4, 5, 10)
- Do NOT use layer 1 for walls — player mask excludes it

**Tile system:** TileMapLayer nodes (grass, roads, town, walls), 32×32 px tiles. Map bounds computed at runtime via `get_used_rect()` in main.gd `_ready()`.

**Damage system:** `take_damage(damage: int, source: Node)` — source is the projectile or monster. Projectiles carry `shooter: Node` pointing back to the monster that fired them. `_identify_killer(source)` in player.gd extracts the script basename for epitaph tracking.

**High scores:** Stored as Array[Dictionary] with keys: score, initials, wave, coins, time_survived, saved_villagers, lost_villagers, epitaph. Epitaph is the death phrase (without initials); display prepends initials at render time.

**Monster base:** All enemies extend monsters.gd. `_cast()` fires projectiles (sets `projectile.shooter = self`). Melee collision passes `self` to `take_damage`. Final boss (mh_orzath.gd) extends monsters.gd.

**Game over flow:**
- Player dies → `Global.killer_name` set → game_over.tscn (high score) or game_over2.tscn
- Boss dies → `_on_boss_died()` in global.gd → victory_scene.tscn
- Victory → "The Wall of Heroes" button → game_over.tscn (no Global.reset() yet)
- game_over.tscn Restart button → Global.reset() → main.tscn
- Guard against simultaneous player+boss death: `_handle_game_over()` returns early if `Global.game_active` is already false

**Touch controls:** touch_controls.tscn (CanvasLayer with two Control nodes). touch_joystick.gd extends Control, uses `_input()` with `InputEventScreenTouch`/`InputEventScreenDrag`, drives `Input.action_press()` with analog strength. Shown only on touchscreen devices via `OS.has_feature("touchscreen")` in ui.gd `_toggle_touch_controls()`. Joystick positions: left (165,500), right (990,500), radius 100.

**Magi health bar:** Created programmatically in `_create_health_bar()`. Must use `offset_left/top/right/bottom` (not `size`/`position`) to match the 19×2px scene-based bars of guard/tenchijin/annadaeus — otherwise Godot theme minimum size overrides the programmatic size.

**Healing aura (priestess):** Shader-based pulse. Key params in priestess.tscn: `shader_parameter/pulse_speed = 3.5`, `shader_parameter/max_alpha = 0.45`, `scale = Vector2(0.9, 0.9)`.

**Mh'Orzath boss:** Event Horizon (range 500, pull_strength 1000, damage 160, cooldown 15s) — pulls targets toward boss then damages. Nihil Storm (range 600, damage 200, cooldown 20s) — pure AoE damage + camera shake.

content.text:
Done. Here's what changes and why:

**`ignore`** — stretches the 1152×648 canvas to fill any screen size, distorting the image on non-16:9 devices (most modern phones are 19:9 or 20:9).

**`expand`** — keeps the 1152×648 as the minimum visible area, then extends the viewport edges outward to fill the screen. No distortion, no black bars. On a tall phone in landscape the player just sees a little more world to the left and right. The camera limits we already added prevent the extra visible area from showing the grey unpainted tiles.

Two things to set in the Android export settings (can't be done in code):
- **Orientation → Landscape** — prevents the game going portrait on phones
- **Immersive Mode** — hides the navigation bar for true edge-to-edge fullscreen
